name: Agri Inputs: Seeds, Fertilisers and Crop Protection

seo.title: Claims Reconciliation for Agri-Input Companies | VipraTech
seo.description: Season-end returns, dealer schemes, cash discounts, retailer loyalty and rate differences, checked for seeds, fertiliser and crop protection companies.

hero.headline: Settle season-end returns and dealer schemes with every line checked
hero.subheadline: Season-end and expiry returns, dealer schemes and cash discounts, and retailer loyalty, checked against your policies and sales.

intro: Seed, fertiliser and crop protection companies sell through distributors and retailers in short, intense seasons, often on credit. At the end of each season come returns of unsold and expiring stock, scheme payouts tied to season targets and collections, and price changes on stock in the channel. All of it has to be settled quickly before the next season's credit opens.

challenges.title: Seasonal returns
challenges.detail: Unsold and expiring stock comes back at season end, batch by batch, under return policies.

challenges.title: Targets and collections
challenges.detail: Dealer schemes depend on season sales and on when dealers paid.

challenges.title: A credit-heavy channel
challenges.detail: Long credit periods make cash discounts and collection-linked rebates central.

challenges.title: Retailer and farmer loyalty
challenges.detail: Points for retailers and farmers are earned on scans and purchases.

use_cases.note: Season-end and expiry returns traced to batches sold to each distributor, within your return policy.
Season schemes, target rebates and cash discounts calculated from billing, returns and collections.
Distributor and retailer scheme claims checked against circulars and invoices.
Retailer and farmer loyalty points compared with sales by town and village.
Price-change claims on channel stock capped at estimated stock on hand.

faqs.q: Our returns spike at season end. Can it keep up?
faqs.a: Yes. Checks run on the whole return file at once, so a season's returns can be checked in days rather than weeks.

faqs.q: Can it handle batch-level expiry for crop protection products?
faqs.a: Yes. Returns are traced to batches sold to each distributor, with expiry dates and return windows applied.
With a free claims audit on last season's returns or scheme claims.
